note: Origin of every file of nfp/film that comes from the documentary engine of branch docu-16x9-test30. 'copied' files are byte-identical to the source (sha256 of both recorded) and must never be edited: a change goes into a new file. 'referenced' files are not copied: the identical file already in the repository is used. 'derived' files are new files based on a source file; their changes are listed. Not taken over: every project of docu/projects (Kim's story, characters, sources, sound cues), the docu-6min-data branch, the Kim workflows, the scene sets 21_scenes.js / 42_scenes_cine.js (Kim-specific texts and palettes; a cleaned version is a later stage).

changes: meta.lang 'en' (default) or 'fa'; Whisper language follows it
projects are folders anywhere (no project store)
unknown top-level / sentence fields are refused
optional per-sentence 'speaker', 'cast' and 'characters' (data, planned by C3)
V4: optional sentence pause_before_ms / pause_after_ms (Voice Engine projects only)
S1: optional top-level 'subtitles' (settings checked by engine/subtitles.py, imported only when present)
--build option
verify always expects 1920x1080 (no 720p path)
compose adds characters through cast_plan.py
fonts directory from NFP_FONTS or assets/fonts
V4: `voice` command (Voice Engine, only for projects with voice.engine); `tts` refused for such projects
S1: `subs` command (subtitle cues + QC -> subtitles.json; data only, the video is unchanged)
S2: `subs` also writes SRT / VTT / ASS from subtitles.json (engine/subtitle_export.py) into <build>/subtitles/
rig 00_core/10_chars read from C2 (byte-identical files); no story-specific scene sets in the kit
fonts and text direction per language (en: Inter/Caveat LTR, fa: Vazirmatn+Inter RTL; SVG art text follows the language through CSS)
words.json (nfp.film.words/1): exact word timing as its own data file; story.srt is a side output
optional character fragment appended before </body>
no local GSAP shim switch (tests swap the CDN tag in a render copy)

S3: projects with a 'subtitles' block draw the cues of subtitles.json (engine/subtitle_layer.py swaps the subtitle CSS / script of base.html between fixed markers); without the block the page is byte-identical
lang/dir placeholders
body font and language CSS placeholders
